name.en-US: On the Tabernacle and the Priestly Vestments
name.pt-BR: Sobre o Tabernáculo e as Vestes dos Sacerdotes

description.la: De tabernaculo et vasis eius ac uestibus sacerdotum libri tres.
description.en-US: Bede's three-book allegorical exposition of the tabernacle, its furnishings and the priestly vestments (Exodus 25-28), read as figures of Christ, the Church and the soul. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A exposição alegórica de Beda, em três livros, sobre o tabernáculo, suas alfaias e as vestes sacerdotais (Êxodo 25-28), lidos como figuras de Cristo, da Igreja e da alma.

sources.edition: De tabernaculo et vestibus sacerdotum on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
